name: obsdog
description: Read existing context and write findings throughout work with ObsDog.

interface.longDescription: Knowledge, made observable. Make memory truly useful. Read existing context, investigate questions, write findings and work state, update matching notes and verify saved content. The connected account supplies the available Spaces.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use ObsDog throughout this task: read related knowledge, write findings, decisions, attempts and results as work progresses, update matching notes and read back saved content. Use the Space selected for this task from the connected account.
